translation.description: Re-encode strings in the default character set.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those.

translation.details: This is stri_encode(str, None, None). A leading BOM is kept. The default charset on this build is UTF-8, so the text comes back unchanged.
translation.value: A string, NA, or a list of those.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_tonative
x = stri_enc_tonative("ą")
print(f"stri_enc_tonative(\"ą\") returns {x}.")
